name: ui/thread-message-stack
title: Thread message stack
desc_vi: Từng tin nhắn nảy vào từ phía người gửi, đẩy các tin cũ lên, trên nền gradient ấm trôi chậm.
params_vi: messages: danh sách {side: incoming | outgoing, text, sender (tuỳ chọn)}, mỗi tin một dòng, xuống dòng bằng \n · stagger: giây giữa 2 tin · hold: giây giữ cuối · duration: độ dài cảnh (giây) · out_fill, out_ink, in_fill, in_ink: màu bong bóng
notes: Same sizes, colours, radii, timings and eases as the source. Differences: font = the film's font (source: -apple-system / Helvetica Neue / Segoe UI system stack); the source measured every row height at mount (offsetHeight), but fonts are not loaded when a preset builds, so the height is computed with the same formula the measurement gives for a single line (bubble 54.6 px per line + 48 px padding, sender row 32 px, pitch = max(118, height) + 22) and a message is one line unless it contains a newline (white-space: pre instead of pre-wrap / overflow-wrap anywhere): break long messages with \n; the source's JSON data block became the messages param (Vietnamese defaults); hold / stagger / duration are params (defaults 1 / 0.86 / 8) and the composition length (8 s) is the demo duration; bubble colours are params. Imitates iMessage-style bubbles (brand_ui).
